prompt_source: LLaVA model-card format: one user turn with task text before image, no system role; explicit JSON schema and example
caption_id_provenance: IDs and names are required in the model response

user_prompt_templates.relations:
Image contains numbered, outlined detections. Listed IDs are the only allowed endpoints. Detection labels: {labels}
Task: report visible physical support relations only. Return exactly one JSON array and nothing else: no Markdown, prose, headings, or code fences. Each item must be ["subject_id","relation","object_id"]. The relation string must be exactly "on top of" or "under". Copy IDs exactly. Use [] when no confident relation is visible. Example: [["3","on top of","8"]].
user_prompt_templates.captions:
Image contains numbered, outlined detections. Listed IDs are the only allowed objects. Detection labels: {labels}
Task: caption each listed visible object separately. Do not write a scene summary. Preserve each detector name as the name field; use a concise visual description for caption. Include every listed ID exactly once and no other IDs. Return exactly one JSON array and nothing else: no Markdown, prose, headings, or code fences. Each item must be {"id":"ID","name":"detector name","caption":"visual description"}. Example: [{"id":"3","name":"chair","caption":"A wooden chair beside the table."}].
user_prompt_templates.targeted_captions: This image has outlined detections with numeric IDs. Focus only on the object outlined with ID {target_id}, whose detector label is {target_name}. Other outlined objects are context only. If the target is identifiable, give one concise factual sentence about its visible appearance and condition. Mention an action only if it clearly applies to this object. Do not describe the whole room or other objects. If the detector label seems wrong, describe the visible object faithfully. If the target cannot be identified clearly, respond with exactly NOT_VISIBLE and do not guess. Return plain text only, with no ID, JSON, Markdown, or explanation.

baseline.source: cached annotations from the same 40-frame modernized detection cache

metric_note: Agreement with cached Qwen3.8 outputs is not ground-truth accuracy.

gpu_memory.nvidia_smi_scope: maximum memory.used among all visible GPUs; includes other processes and desktop baseline

usable_caption_observations.definition: Detection observation with a nonempty description and resolvable ID/name; batch mode also requires valid JSON array schema; targeted IDs are prompt-linked then cache-attached.
